description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseRAGIngestion' for performing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion processes. It includes methods for file upload, OCR, chunking, embedding, and storing data into vector stores, designed to be extended by provider-specific subclasses.

classes.name: BaseRAGIngestion
classes.description: Abstract base class for RAG ingestion pipelines, providing skeleton implementations for uploading files, OCR processing, chunking, embedding, and storing data; intended for subclassing with provider-specific storage implementations.

methods.description: Handles uploading or fetching files via bytes, URL, or existing file ID.

methods.name: Optional[str] ocr( self, file_content: Optional[bytes], content_type: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Performs OCR on image files to extract text, supporting different content types and utilizing a router or direct API call.

methods.name: List[str] chunk( self, text: Optional[str], file_content: Optional[bytes], ocr_was_used: bool, )
methods.description: Splits text data into smaller chunks using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter with configurable parameters.

methods.name: Optional[List[List[float]]] embed( self, chunks: List[str], )
methods.description: Generates text embeddings for chunks using specified embedding models.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] store( self, file_content: Optional[bytes], filename: Optional[str], content_type: Optional[str], chunks: List[str], embeddings: Optional[List[List[float]]], )
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for storing data in a vector store.

methods.name: RAGIngestResponse ingest( self, file_data: Optional[Tuple[str, bytes, str]] = None, file_url: Optional[str] = None, file_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Orchestrates the overall ingestion process: upload, OCR, chunking, embedding, and storing.
